info.name: 03 Method Security
info.description: Every user on every secured service method. Run in order, on a freshly started app: folders 4 and 5 change data and set it back, folder 8 deletes employees 6 and 7 (restart the app to run again). Users: admin (ADMIN), hana (HR), manoj (MANAGER of 4 and 5), asha (USER, employee 4), ravi (USER, employee 5).
